estimand: Within-recording EGG spectral peak diagnostics, all independent channels and complete recording-relative windows; no clinical inference
quadratic_note: Additional whole-window quadratic detrending is diagnostic, not a chosen correction; all variants retain per-segment linear detrending
peak_definition: Strict local maximum at an interior FFT bin of the broad band; boundary maxima flagged separately; all local maxima retained, no prominence threshold
matching_interpretation: One original 128-second FFT spacing; descriptive only, not physiological reliability acceptance
